name: Puff Heart
summary: A like button whose heart inflates into a balloon, floats up the post and pops into confetti hearts
about: A like button on a photo post. Liking squashes the heart while air puffs in, then it swells and fills from the bottom, floats away as a heart balloon on a swaying string while a fresh heart springs into the button, and pops into drifting confetti hearts. Unliking lets the air out with a sigh, and a double-tap on the picture likes it too.
how: Hover the button: the heart wiggles. Press it, or Tab to it and press Enter or Space.
The button dips, the heart squashes and little puffs of air rush in.
The heart swells with a wobble and fills with colour from the bottom while the count rolls up.
It floats away as a balloon on a trailing string, a new heart springs into the button, then the balloon pops into drifting hearts.
Double-click or double-tap the picture to like it from there. Press again to unlike: the heart sighs out its air and drains.
